home.pitch: Chrysalide is a fine-dining restaurant in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon, focused on a modern approach to crust cooking. We explore this technique in all its forms to concentrate the essence of each ingredient and the transfer of flavours.

concept.title: Concept
concept.subtitle: Concentrate, transform, reveal
concept.name_text: The name Chrysalide perfectly matched the thread of our reflection. The chrysalis is the state of transformation, the transition between the caterpillar and the butterfly. It represents a closed space where an invisible metamorphosis takes place — universally understood. This imagery directly echoes our cuisine, centred on crust cooking and slow-braised techniques, where ingredients evolve in a cocoon and finally reveal themselves at the moment of service.
concept.logo_text: The logo depicts a broken crust seen from the side — the symbol of the key moment of the experience: the opening of the shell, where aromas and flavours are revealed. Its minimal, refined line underlines the contemporary gastronomic approach of the project.
concept.da_text: The visual identity of Chrysalide is rooted in a wabi-sabi aesthetic blended with a rustic, ancient influence. Wabi-sabi celebrates imperfection and simplicity, directly in tune with a kitchen that transforms, preserves and reveals flavours. The rustic universe anchors the project in something tangible and sincere.
